name.description: kebab-case id, doubles as docs slug and CLI arg

family.description: Component family for docs IA (e.g. buttons, inputs, notices)

status.description: Per-artifact lifecycle status — drives the public status matrix

dependencies.description: Other registry components this one requires (CLI installs them too)

files.description: Files the CLI copies into a consumer repo

target.description: Path relative to the consumer's rata directory

behavior.description: The headless contract: what this component does independently of React and of any styling, plus the API decisions a parser cannot recover from source.

primitive.description: Exported function in packages/primitives/src/<name>.ts. Verified to exist at build time.

decisions.description: Design decisions worth defending, each with its reason — the record of what was approved at gate 1.

props.description: The WRITTEN half of the component contract, keyed by prop name: what each prop is for, judgment a parser cannot recover. The DERIVED half (type, optionality, default, extends) is parsed from packages/react/src/<name>.tsx and must not be restated here once the component is implemented. While status.react is `future` there is no source to parse, so `type`/`default`/`required` are written here instead and the contract stands as the approved intent.

summary.description: One line: what this prop is for.

dont.description: What it is not for, and what to do instead.

conflicts.description: Sibling props that should not be combined with this one. Each must be a real prop of this component.

a11y.description: The accessibility obligation this prop carries or places on the caller.

type.description: Spec mode only (status.react: future). Once implemented, type is derived from source.

default.description: Spec mode only. Once implemented, defaults are derived from the component's parameter list.

required.description: Spec mode only. Once implemented, optionality is derived from the props interface.

usage.description: Worked use cases — the cross-prop guidance that no single prop entry owns.

example.description: A real snippet. Linted against the token rules by internal/vibe-tests.

notes.description: What is easy to get wrong here.

tokens.description: This component's token recipe, one entry per variant (`base` for a single-variant component). Read by packages/tokens/src/theme/readContracts.mjs and rendered into TOKENS.md's component recipes.
CSS property (or described role) → token path.
